title: Imifuno nezityalo eziyisiseko
description: Ukulungiselela amabhedi, ukutyala ngokulandelelana, izityalo eziyisiseko nolawulo lwezitshabalalisi — umsebenzi wemihla ngemihla wokukhulisa ukutya.

lessons.title: Ukulungiselela nokutyala amabhedi akho
lessons.body:
Umhlaba ocinezelekileyo (compacted) ulahlekelwa zizithuba zawo zomoya. Iingcambu ziyacotha. Amanzi angena ngendlela eyahlukileyo. Ibhedi iba nzima ngakumbi ukuyisebenza ixesha ngalinye lonyaka.

Ukukhusela kulula. Iindlela ezisisigxina, kunye nebhedi emxinwa ngokwaneleyo ukuze ufikelele embindini usuka macala omabini.

Ububanzi obuyimitha e-1 ukuya kwi-1.2. Yinani elisebenzayo elo. Kububanzi obunjalo unokufikelela embindini usuka kwenye yeendlela, kwaye iinyawo zakho azize ziyichukumise indawo ekulinywa kuyo.

Ngoku cinga ngamabhedi akho. Ngaba unokufikelela embindini ungangeni ngaphakathi? Yiya uzame oko phambi kokuba utyale enye into.

Akukho simo sibhedi esinye esilungileyo kuyo yonke indawo.

Qala ngeyona ndlela iphazamisa umhlaba kancinci, kodwa esonjulula ingxaki yakho.

Indlela yokungembi (no-dig) ilungele uninzi lwemihlaba yegadi. Ungawuphazamisi ulwakhiwo lwawo, wakhe ubutyebi bomhlaba phezulu.

Musa ukumba udongwe olumanzi. Ukuba ukucinezeleka komhlaba okanye ukungaphumi kakuhle kwamanzi kubi kakhulu, chonga unobangela ngokufumana icebiso lasekuhlaleni phambi kokukhetha ukulima nzulu ngakumbi.

Amabhedi aphakanyisiweyo (raised beds) alungele umhlaba omanzi, apho amanzi efuna indawo anokuhamba kuyo.

Amabhedi angena emhlabeni (sunken beds) alungele umhlaba owomileyo, apho ufuna ukubamba nokugcina imvula oyifumanayo.

Jonga emva kwemvula enkulu. Amanzi ahlala phi okanye abaleka phi? Dibanisa oko ukubonileyo necebiso lomhlaba nelokuphuma kwamanzi phambi kokukhetha ibhedi.

Ezinye izityalo azikuthandi ukuphazanyiswa kweengcambu zazo. Zikhula kakuhle xa zihlwayelwa ngqo apho ziza kukhula khona. Iimbotyi, iminqathe (carrots) nombona zikweli qela.

Ezinye zikhula kakuhle xa ziqala zikhuselekile kwindawo yokuhlwayela imbewu (nursery), emva koko zitshintshelwe kwenye indawo. Iitumato neebrassica (izityalo zosapho lwekhaphetshu) zikweli qela.

Sebenzisa isikhokelo somgama phakathi kwezityalo ngokwesityalo, uhlobo lwaso neemeko zasekuhlaleni. Jonga ipakethi yembewu necebiso labalimi basekuhlaleni. Qaphela ukuxinana njengoko izityalo zikhula.

Phambi kokuba utyale, phawula ibhedi.

Ububanzi obuyimitha e-1.2. Ubude obuyimitha emithathu. Ibhedi enye yokuziqhelanisa.

Sebenzisa izikhonkwane nentambo. Phawula unxande, uphawule neendlela zombini zokufikelela.

Emva koko lungiselela umhlaba wakho — qala ngokungembi, kwaye wembe nzulu kuphela xa umhlaba wakho uyidinga ngokwenene.

Umgca wentambo uguqula ingcamango ibe sisigqibo. Xa iindlela sele zikhona, zigcine. Xa indawo ekulinywa kuyo sele ikhona, ikhusele.

Loo bhedi iba lula ngakumbi ukuyiphucula ixesha ngalinye lonyaka, kuba uyekile ukuhamba phezu kwayo.
keyPoints: Gcina amabhedi enobubanzi be-1-1.2m ukuze ungaze ufune ukunyathela kwindawo ekulinywa kuyo
Vavanya ukucinezeleka komhlaba nokuphuma kwamanzi phambi kokukhetha ukulima nzulu ngakumbi; musa ukusebenza kudongwe olumanzi
Tshintshela izityalo ezifuna ukuqala kakuhle; hlwayela ngqo izityalo ezingakuthandi ukuphazanyiswa kweengcambu
Izityalo ezixinene azikhuli kakuhle — shiya umgama owaneleyo ngokwemozulu yasekuhlaleni

quiz.q: Kutheni ugcina ibhedi yemifuno inobubanzi be-1-1.2m kunokuba ibanzi ngakumbi?
options: Amabhedi anabanzi afumana ilanga elininzi kakhulu
Unokufikelela embindini usuka macala omabini ungayinyatheli indawo ekulinywa kuyo, ukuphepha ukucinezeleka komhlaba
Amabhedi amxinwa aphuma kakuhle amanzi kuzo zonke iimeko
quiz.rationale: Ukunyathela emhlabeni olinywayo kuyawucinezela kwaye konakalise iingcambu — ibhedi ofikelela kuyo macala omabini ithetha ukuba akuyi kuze kufuneke wenjenjalo.

quiz.q: Sesiphi isityalo esilungele ukuhlwayelwa ngqo kunokuba sitshintshelwe?
quiz.rationale: Iimbotyi nezinye izityalo ezikhawulezayo, ezineengcambu ezibuthathaka, zikhula kakubi emva kokothuka kokutshintshelwa — ukuzihlwayela ngqo ebhedini kuyayiphepha loo ngxaki ngokupheleleyo.

lessons.infographicAlt: Ibhedi ephakanyisiweyo ebanzi malunga nemitha e-1.2, enendlela macala omabini, ukuze umntu afikelele embindini usuka macala omabini ngaphandle kokuma kanye phezu komhlaba ekulinywa kuwo.

lessons.title: Ukutyala ngokulandelelana nokuxuba izityalo
lessons.body:
Ukutyala ngokulandelelana (succession planting) yimikhwa yekhalenda, hayi isityalo esikhethekileyo.

Khetha into edliwa rhoqo yikhaya lakho. Emva koko uhlwayele isixa esincinci sayo, kuphindaphindwe.

Tyala umqolo omfutshane rhoqo emva kweeveki ezimbini ukuya kwezintathu.

Ukonakala kuncinci xa kunesivuno esiphuphumayo. Ukutya okutsha ixesha elide. Kwaye umsebenzi usasazeka ebudeni bexesha lonyaka endaweni yokuwela phezu kwakho kanye.

Ukuhlwayela ngamaxesha ahlukeneyo kunokunciphisa ingozi yokulahlekelwa yiyo yonke into kanye. Akuqinisekisi isivuno ukuba iimeko ezinzima ziyaqhubeka.

Sisiphi isityalo esikhawulezayo onokusihlwayela ngamaqela amancinci? Khetha esinye, uqale kule veki.

Nantsi indlela ekubonakala ngayo ekusebenzeni.

Hlwayela eyodwa. Emva koko emva kweeveki ezimbini ukuya kwezintathu, hlwayela ezimbini. Emva koko hlwayela ezintathu. Emva koko hlwayela ezine.

Ngexesha elifanelekileyo lesityalo, izivuno ziyakwazi ukuqala ukudibana. Iqela lokuqala alisoloko lilungile ngexesha lokuhlwayela okwesine.

Iiveki ezimbini ukuya kwezintathu sisingqi sokuqala, asingomthetho. Isityalo samagqabi sexesha elibandayo sinokuhlala ixesha elide. Ubushushu bunokukhawulezisa izinto, okanye bubangele ukuba isityalo singaphumeleli.

Qaphela oko igadi yakho ikwenzayo, kwaye uguqule ixesha eliphakathi kokuhlwayela. Oko kuqwalasela kokona buchule.

Ukuxuba izityalo (intercropping) akukuthi nje ukuzixinaniselanisa izityalo ezahlukeneyo. Isityalo ngasinye sidinga umsebenzi, nendawo eyaneleyo yokuwenza.

I-Three Sisters ngumzekelo ovela kwizithethe zokulima zabantu bomthonyama baseMerika (the Americas).

Umbona unika ukuphakama nesakhiwo.

Iimbotyi ziyakhwela kumbona, kwaye zigcina iprotheyini.

Ithanga lisasazeka emhlabeni, lisithile umhlaba kwaye ligcina ukumanzi.

Ixesha liyabaluleka. Qala umbona kuqala, ukuze ube nokomelela ngokwaneleyo ukuthwala iimbotyi xa ziqala ukukhwela.

Izityalo zisenokukhuphisana. Zinike indawo, amanzi nokukhanya okufanelekileyo. Iimbotyi zibamba inayitrojeni kunye neebhaktheriya zeengcambu, kodwa musa ukuthatha ngokuthi zondla umbona kwangoko; izondlo ezikwintsalela zikhululwa ngexesha lokubola.

Ikhaya linokuba nesikhewu sendlala (hungry gap): iiveki apho ukutya okugciniweyo kuncipha phambi kokuba isivuno esilandelayo silunge.

Eyakho isenokuza emva kokuba umbona ogciniweyo uphelile. Isenokuza phambi kokuba imifuno eluhlaza yasebusika ilunge. Isenokuza ngexesha elomileyo apho amanzi ekhawulela igadi.

Musa ukukopa ikhalenda yomnye umntu. Qala ngokubiza amagama eenyanga zakho.

Zibhale phantsi. Emva koko ukhethe isityalo nomhla wokuhlwayela ofaka ukutya kuloo sikhewu.

Oko kukucwangcisa ubuyela umva, kwaye yiyo eyahlula igadi ebonakala ivelisa kwikhaya elidlayo ngokwenene.
keyPoints: Hlwayela ngamaxesha ahlukeneyo kwaye uguqule ixesha eliphakathi ngokwesityalo, imozulu nokusetyenziswa kwasekhaya
I-Three Sisters ivela kwizithethe zokulima zabantu bomthonyama baseMerika (the Americas)
Sebenzisa iirekhodi zokutya kwasekhaya ukuchonga isikhewu sendlala kwaye ucwangcise ngaso
Izityalo ezixutyiweyo zisenokukhuphisana; lawula indawo, ixesha namanzi

quiz.q: Kutheni uhlwayela ilethisi (lettuce) ngamaqela amancinci rhoqo emva kweeveki ezi-2-3 kunokuba kube kanye?
options: Inika isivuno esizinzileyo endaweni yesivuno esiphuphumayo emva koko kulandele isikhewu
quiz.rationale: Ukuhlwayela okukhulu kanye kuvuthwa kanye — ukuhlwayela ngamaxesha ahlukeneyo kusasaza isivuno ukuze sihambelane noko ikhaya linokukusebenzisa ngokwenene.

quiz.q: Inayitrojeni ekwintsalela yezityalo zeembotyi iba lufumaneka nini kwezinye izityalo?
options: Kwangoko nanini na xa imbotyi ichukumisa umbona
Xa izinto eziphilayo zomhlaba ziyibola intsalela
Kuphela xa amagqabi ethanga esithile kuyo
quiz.rationale: Iimbotyi zibamba inayitrojeni kunye neebhaktheriya zeengcambu ezifanelekileyo. Inayitrojeni ekwintsalela yazo ikhululwa ngokubola; ukukhulisa iimbotyi ecaleni kombona akuqinisekisi ukondla kwangoko.

lessons.infographicAlt: Ibhedi enye kwamaxesha amathathu onyaka: isityalo esikhawulezayo siyavunwa, emva koko ukuhlwayela okutsha kuyangena ecaleni kwesityalo esicothayo esisakhula, ukuze ibhedi ingaze ibe ngenanto.

lessons.title: Izityalo eziyisiseko: umbona, iimbotyi nemifuno yeengcambu
lessons.body:
Isityalo esiyisiseko sifanelwe sisikhundla saso kuba sondla ikhaya ngaphaya kosuku lwesivuno.

Sithwala amandla okanye iprotheyini. Siyagcinwa, okanye sihlala emhlabeni ude usidinge. Kwaye rhoqo sithwala nenkumbulo yenkcubeko.

Isityalo esiyisiseko esinye sikushiya ungakhuselekanga. Ezimbini okanye ngaphezulu zikunika ukhetho xa imozulu okanye izitshabalalisi zibetha.

Lima ubuncinane ezimbini. Hayi enye.

Sesiphi isityalo esiyisiseko ekuxhomekeke kuso ikhaya lakho kakhulu ngoku? Yiloo nto engahlukumeza kakhulu ukuba ayiphumelelanga — ngoko yiyo leyo efuna iqabane.

Isityalo ngasinye esiyisiseko sikukhusela kwinto eyahlukileyo.

Umbona unika iikhalori, kwaye ugcinwa womile. Umbona we-open-pollinated (uthuli lwentyatyambo lwawo luthwalwa ngokwendalo ngumoya okanye zizinambuzane) ukuvumela ukuba ugcine nembewu yakho, ukuba ulawula ukwahlukaniswa kwezityalo (isolation) nokukhetha (selection).

Iimbotyi ne-cowpeas zinika isivuno seprotheyini enokugcinwa.

Ibhatata iphuhlisa ukunyamezela imbalela ngokuthile emva kokuba iingcambu zokugcina sezenziwe. Ifuna amanzi kwiiveki zokuqala nangoxa iingcambu zisenziwa; uxinzelelo lwamanzi ngelo xesha lunokunciphisa isivuno. Amagqabi ayo amancinci nawo ayadleka.

Amadumbe asinda emhlabeni omanzi ngakumbi, apho ezinye izityalo eziyisiseko zilwa.

Qaphela ukuba ziyasilela kwiimeko ezahlukeneyo. Yiloo nto kanye.

Ukunyamezela akuthethi ukuba akukho nto isilelayo.

Kuthetha ukuba ukusilela okunye akuliphelisi icebo lokutya lekhaya lakho.

Isityalo esinye siyindawo enye yokusilela.

Izityalo ezimbini okanye ngaphezulu eziyisiseko zikunika iindlela ezininzi zokuqhubeka udla.

Izityalo ezahlukeneyo zisebenzisa amanzi, umhlaba namaxesha ngokwahlukeneyo. Loo mahluko yikhuseleko.
keyPoints: Umbona we-open-pollinated ukuvumela ugcine imbewu; imbewu ye-hybrid ayizi kuvelisa izityalo ezifana nomzali kwixesha elilandelayo
Iimbotyi sisityalo seprotheyini esibalulekileyo — siyavelisa, siyagcinwa, kwaye sibamba inayitrojeni
Ibhatata iphuhlisa ukunyamezela imbalela ngokuthile emva kokuba iingcambu zokugcina sezenziwe, kodwa ifuna amanzi kwangoko; amagqabi amancinci ayadleka
Amadumbe (taro) sisityalo esiyisiseko sesintu esingasetyenziswa kakhulu, esilungele umhlaba omanzi we-KZN nowaselunxwemeni

quiz.q: Kutheni ukhetha umbona we-open-pollinated kunohlobo lwe-hybrid ukuba uceba ukugcina imbewu yakho?
options: Imbewu ye-hybrid ayizi kuvelisa ngokufanayo — isizukulwana esilandelayo asiyi kufana nesityalo somzali
Umbona we-open-pollinated usoloko unyamezela imbalela ngakumbi
quiz.rationale: Imbewu egcinwe kwi-F1 hybrid isenokukhula, kodwa isizukulwana esilandelayo sisenokwahluka. Uhlobo oluzinzileyo lwe-open-pollinated olunempova elawulwayo luyaqikelelwa ngakumbi xa kugcinwa imbewu.

quiz.q: Kutheni amadumbe (taro) ekhetho elilungileyo njengesityalo esiyisiseko kwezinye iindawo ze-KZN?
options: Akhula kakuhle emhlabeni owomileyo kakhulu onesanti
Anyamezela umhlaba omanzi ngaphezu kombona, elungele iimeko zonxweme neendawo ezinemvula eninzi
Sesona sityalo siyisiseko sodwa esigcinwa iminyaka emininzi
quiz.rationale: Amadumbe enyaneni akhetha umhlaba onomswakama apho umbona wawuza kuzabalaza — agcwalisa isikhundla ezinye izityalo eziyisiseko ezingenakusizalisa kakuhle.

lessons.infographicAlt: Izityalo ezintathu eziyisiseko kunye: isiqu eside sokusanhlamvu, isityalo esikhwelayo kwisibonda, nesityalo sengcambu esibonakala sisemhlabeni isiqingatha.

lessons.title: Jonga uze ulawule izitshabalalisi nezifo
lessons.body:
Uxinzelelo lwezitshabalalisi lunyuka ngesizathu.

Izityalo ezikuxinzelelo. Isityalo esinye esilawula umhlaba. Okanye ukusetyenziswa kakhulu kweekhemikhali sele kwasusa izilwanyana ezizingelayo ebezikunceda.

Ngoko phambi kokuba unyange nantoni na, jonga yonke inkqubo.

Ngaba isityalo sinqongophele amanzi? Ngaba umhlaba ucinezelekile, okanye awunazondlo ezaneleyo? Ngaba izilwanyana ezizingelayo sele zisebenza ukusonjulula ingxaki?

Igqabi elimthubi aliyiyo ngokuzenzekelayo inambuzane. Linokuba ngamanzi, ukondliwa, okanye umonakalo wengcambu. Zazi ukuba kungoluphi phambi kokuba wenze nto.

Landela amanyathelo amane, ngokulandelelana.

Okokuqala. Jonga. Jonga indlela umonakalo obonakala ngayo, ingaphantsi legqabi, isiqu, nezityalo ezikufutshane.

Okwesibini. Khangela uxinzelelo. Ukumanza komhlaba, iingcambu, umgama phakathi kwezityalo, ukondliwa, ukuphuma kwamanzi.

Okwesithathu. Khusela abakunceda. Izinambuzane ezinceda zenza umsebenzi obungawenza wena.

Okwesine. Kuphela emva koko, yenza into — kwaye uqale ngento elula esebenzayo. Ukususa ngokwasemzimbeni, imiqobo okanye utshintsho kunakekelo lwesityalo kunokunceda. Qinisekisa ukuba isenzo sifanelana nengxaki kwaye ubone iziphumo.

Ukuba unyango luyadingeka, sebenzisa imveliso ebhaliselwe eso sityalo nesitshabalalisi, kwaye ulandele ileyibhile yayo. Oku kubandakanya iimveliso ze-neem. Jonga imiyalelo yokhuseleko nexesha lokulinda phambi kokuvuna. Musa ukuyila imixube okanye iidosi ezomeleleyo ngakumbi.

Yiba nyanisekile kuwe ngowuphi umnyathelo osoloko ewutsiba.
keyPoints: Khangela amanzi, iingcambu, ukondliwa nezinambuzane ezinceda
Sebenzisa amanyathelo afanelekileyo ongokwasemzimbeni okanye okunakekela isityalo kwaye ubone iziphumo
Ukuba unyango luyadingeka, sebenzisa imveliso ebhaliselwe isityalo nesitshabalalisi kwaye ulandele ileyibhile

quiz.q: Ukuba ingxaki yesitshabalalisi idinga imveliso yonyango, yintoni ekufanele ikhokele ukusetyenziswa kwayo?
options: Imveliso ebhaliselwe isityalo nesitshabalalisi, isetyenziswe ngokweleyibhile yayo
quiz.rationale: Isityalo, isitshabalalisi, idosi, ukhuseleko nemiyalelo yexesha lokulinda phambi kokuvuna kuyabalulekile. Imvelaphi yendalo ayenzi unyango oluyilwe ngokwakho lukhuseleke okanye lufanelekile.

quiz.q: Amagqabi eebrassica zomfama ayajika abe mthubi. Phambi kokucinga ukuba zizitshabalalisi, ufanele ajonge ntoni kuqala?
options: Ukuba ngokwenene yingxaki yezondlo zomhlaba okanye yokunisela
Ukuba isigaba senyanga silungile na kunyango
quiz.rationale: Ukuba mthubi kwamagqabi kunezizathu ezininzi eziqhelekileyo, kwaye ingxaki yezondlo zomhlaba okanye yokunisela idinga isisombululo esahlukileyo ngokupheleleyo kunesitshabalalisi — ukujonga kuqala kuphepha unyango olulahlekileyo.

lessons.infographicAlt: Isitshabalalisi kwigqabi, neendlela ezintathu zokusilawula ngaphandle kweekhemikhali: inambuzane enceda, umqobo ongokwasemzimbeni, nokusikha ngesandla.
